comparisonPrecisionNormalization.purpose: Only independent overlay operands use the common 1e12 grid. Validity, DE9IM overlap, final shared-segment ownership and outline displacement checks use original output coordinates.
comparisonPrecisionNormalization.areaBoundMethod: Each rounded ring lies within maximum vertex displacement of the original ring; the conservative two-sided boundary-band bound is 2 * perimeter * displacement + PI * displacement^2.
